info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Customer Credit Rating Update API
info.description: The Customer Credit Rating Update API provides an interface for modifying the credit rating details of individual customers. This API is essential for financial institutions and credit agencies that need to adjust customer credit scores based on updated information or changed circumstances. Users may typically include credit analysts, customer service representatives, and financial application developers who need to ensure accurate credit information for decision-making purposes. This endpoint supports maintaining the integrity and accuracy of customer financial data through efficient updates.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the credit rating information for a specific customer identified by their unique ID. Ensure that you provide the necessary details in the request body to reflect the changes to their credit rating.

requestBody.description: This request body is used for updating the credit rating of a specific customer identified by CUST-100045. The JSON object should contain the updated credit information for the customer.

200.description: Request completed successfully, and the credit rating has been updated.
